messages:
Zoe: Massive shoutout to Carlos and Mei for fixing the conference room A/C before the all-hands — saved the presentation! :ice_cube: :clap:

Carlos: doh it was totally a duct clip that slipped. Mei spotted it and I owe her coffee. :coffee:

Mei: lol I just followed the mysterious hum. Also shoutout to @Zoe for coordinating the AV folks quickly.

Zoe: Teamwork. Also — stickers + mini awards for the helpers? people-ops said we can do small treats.

people-ops: Hey! Yes we can cover small tokens. Submit a short expense with the note "kudos treats" and we'll approve. :white_check_mark:

Carlos: I left a stack of 'Thanks!' stickers in the pantry labeled "for heroes". :label:

Mei: omg adorable. Can we do a 1-min recognition during retro tomorrow?

Zoe: Yes please. Quick poll for tomorrow snack: `/poll "Thanks treat" "Cupcakes" "Matcha cookies" "Savory mini quiche" "Skip snacks (stickers only)"`

snack-bot: Poll created in #random by Zoe: "Thanks treat" — vote now! :ballot_box: 

stickers-bot: Automated note: 6 sticker reacts added to messages mentioning Carlos this week. Suggested bundle: 10x 'hero' stickers.

Carlos: wow thanks y'all, no need for big fuss — extra coffee and stickers made my week. :heart_eyes:

Zoe: Alright — I'll collect receipts and drop the retro 1-min on the agenda. Big thanks again. GIF of duct-taming Mei incoming. https://gifs.example.com/mei-duct-tamer.gif
